sources.locator: Environment and Natural Resources Journal 11(1), 2013, PDF pp. 25-26: Thai palm biodiesel case, assumed transport distances, inventory sources, mass allocation
sources.finding: Historical Thai case reports an assumed 20 km round-trip transport segment and mass allocation between CPO/kernel and biodiesel/glycerin, using mixed Thai LCI, ecoinvent and literature sources. Its FU, technology and source vintage do not establish compatible providers or activity for the current 1000 MJ FAME case.

sources.locator: Search-indexed article abstract and method excerpt; DOI redirect could not be opened for full text in this review
sources.finding: Indexed text describes spatially differentiated Thai transport LCA and Thai biodiesel data based on 2013 Thai National LCI, with ecoinvent 3.8 background. Full tables and underlying inventory were not inspectable.

Confirms Thai National LCI database service publishes inventory and impact information; landing page did not expose the specific biodiesel record, exchanges, version, period, provider or record license required here.

sources.locator: Journal abstract and methods: B100 tested in 441 kW marine engine and 177 kW generator under stated loads
sources.finding: Thai palm-oil B100 engine test reports BSFC, efficiency, exhaust temperature and CO; it does not match the pickup-truck use context or supply matched CH4/N2O factors for the current study.

limits: Targeted search is not a systematic review.
The 2025 DOI full text could not be inspected in this review; search-indexed excerpts were not used as inventory data.
The Thai LCI landing page is not evidence for the content or licensing of an individual dataset record.
No evidence was found to close current allocation, provider compatibility, use-phase, treatment or background-exchange gates.
